rh-afro-1: Kalimba/djembe afrobeat; long 8-bar intro, only one short breather; laid-back 16ths
rh-afro-2: Balafon/djembe afrobeat that follows the plan: intro, A, breather, B (highlife guitar + bell), breather, C (full drums); tight beat
rh-island-1: Steel-pan calypso with clean breathers between three grooves (calypso, soca, carnival); tightest beat of the set
rh-island-2: Marimba/steel-pan calypso; second half is one long section, the beat wobbles in the breathers
rh-hiphop-1: Boom-bap with scratches, then one long half-time section (no funk-break C); swung 16ths; tight kicks
rh-hiphop-2: Boom-bap (scratches) | half-time 808 section | funk break with horns, with breathers between; swung 16ths (2:1), tight kick/snare, laid-back melody
rh-reggae-1: Melodica reggae: long intro, one-drop groove then steppers, no real breathers; very steady
rh-reggae-2: Flute reggae; one long groove after the intro, no section changes detected
rh-bossa-1: Nylon-guitar bossa then one long batucada/flute section; soft pulse (beat hard to measure)
rh-bossa-2: Rhodes/flute bossa with samba percussion; steady beat but no section changes
rh-tango-1: Bandoneon tango: habanera | marcato | milonga, each after a full stop (silent breathers); start calibrated by -14 ms
rh-tango-2: Accordion tango in many short fragments with rubato; beat wanders (not usable for the game)
rh-flamenco-1: Rumba flamenca: strum + palmas + cajon, then contratiempo palmas/castanets; one short break
rh-flamenco-2: Rumba flamenca as one long groove; beat hard to follow
rh-bossa-3: Nylon-guitar bossa | samba batucada | bossa+samba with flute, with drum stops between; steady beat
rh-flamenco-3: Rumba flamenca with crisp palmas: rumba groove | contratiempo + castanets after a one-bar stop; tightest flamenco take
